run_rocm_scaled_mm: run FP8 per-tensor w8a8 scaled matrix multiplication on ROCm MI3xx hardware
test_rocm_is_supported: test whether ROCm FP8 scaled MM linear kernel is supported on the current platform
test_rocm_can_implement: test whether the ROCm kernel can implement a given FP8 scaled MM linear layer config
apply_rocm_scaled_mm: apply ROCm FP8 scaled matrix multiplication with activation and weight scales to tensors A and B
register_rocm_custom_op: register the ROCm FP8 scaled MM custom op with its fake implementation for tracing
